name: Neon Kowloon
desc: A cyberpunk vision of Kowloon Walled City — neon signs, rain-slicked streets, and Eastern architecture fused with futuristic tech. Part of the Cyber Orient collection.

name: Flying Apsara
desc: Dunhuang flying apsara reimagined in contemporary line work. The silk medium itself echoes the Silk Road that once carried these images westward.

name: The Last Emperor
desc: A French artist's interpretation of Puyi, the last emperor of China. Part of The Other Gaze — dedicated to non-Eastern artists redefining Oriental themes.

name: Dragon Mecha
desc: The Chinese dragon reimagined as a biomechanical mecha. Ancient mythology meets futuristic engineering in the Eastern Sci-Fi collection.

name: Bruce Lee — The Flow
desc: Bruce Lee captured in mid-flow — not a photograph, but an artistic co-creation between illustrator A. Rivera and the LYS studio. Legends Gallery celebrates iconic figures through artistic interpretation.

name: Midnight Jazz
desc: The visual language of jazz — smoky clubs, brass curves, and midnight rhythms — translated into silk. Sonic Echoes explores where sound becomes image.

name: Palace Geometry
desc: Forbidden City architectural patterns deconstructed into contemporary geometry. Palace Reimagined brings imperial heritage into the 21st century.

name: Erlang Shen
desc: Erlang Shen, the three-eyed deity of Chinese mythology, rendered in bold contemporary style. Nantian Gate is our character-driven mythology collection.

name: Ink Bloom
desc: A single plum blossom dissolving into ink wash. Eastern Mood is about negative space, stillness, and the feeling between brushstrokes.

name: Wall Dragon
desc: A dragon mural found on a Shanghai back alley, photographed and re-rendered for silk. Eastern Street brings urban art into the gallery.

name: Akira Requiem
desc: A tribute to anime's most iconic cyberpunk moments. Anime Universe celebrates the visual language of Japanese animation, from cel-shading to modern digital.

name: The Godfather — Silk Cut
desc: The 1/1 NFT edition of this season's Cinema Collection centerpiece. An original interpretation of The Godfather's iconic silhouette, on silk, with blockchain-verified provenance. Auctioned separately to the highest bidder.
